description.zh: 加密参数名称。取值范围：内容限制为字母、数字、中划线、下划线，长度不能超过180字符，且不能以ALIYUN、ACS、ALIBABA、ALICLOUD、OOS开头。
description.en: The name of the encrypted parameter. The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (\_). The name must be no more than 180 characters in length. The name cannot start with ALIYUN, ACS, ALIBABA, ALICLOUD, or OOS.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun oos delete-secret-parameter --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --name MySecretParameter --region cn-hangzhou
